company.name: Skipr Technologies
company.shortDescription: Skipr enables governments and enterprises to govern, execute, and prove every action taken by AI, agents, users, and machines.
company.description:
Skipr is the Sovereign Intelligence, Control & Execution Platform for the autonomous
era. As AI agents, people, and machines increasingly act across and beyond the
organization, the question is no longer whether systems can connect, but who
governs what they do. Existing tools — IAM, PAM, Zero Trust, SIEM — were built for
human access and after-the-fact monitoring. Skipr is the layer that governs
autonomous action itself: every request from a person, agent, or machine is
understood, reasoned over, authorized, executed, and proven — under the
organization’s own jurisdiction, on infrastructure it controls, with no vendor lock-in.
Built for telecom operators, governments, defense, sovereign cloud providers, and
regulated enterprises. 

Own your runtime. Govern your future.
